* Returns the name of the handler type produced by this factory * (e.g. {@code TEXT}, {@code MARKDOWN}, {@code HTML}, {@code XML}). *

* This value is written to * {@link org.apache.tika.metadata.TikaCoreProperties#TIKA_CONTENT_HANDLER_TYPE} * so that downstream components (such as the inference pipeline) can * determine what format {@code tika:content} is in without guessing. * * @return handler type name, never {@code null}
